content: Melvin-Koushki cites Mohammad Masad for the link between confessional ambiguity and interest in the occult sciences: in the 7th/13th century apocalyptic tradition the Imams are the repositories of hidden knowledge for Sunni and Shiʿi alike, so that Sunni practitioners of divination (jafr) are confessionally indistinguishable from Shiʿi ones.
refers_to_primary: Masad, ‘The Medieval Islamic Apocalyptic Tradition’, pp.142-66 (per MK)
